pages.text: I knew I could not win. You were stronger than I ever was, because you never fought the voice. You let it carry you, and it carried you all the way here. I was like you once. The roots whispered to me too, and I answered with a blade. You answered with your hand. They called me the Nightblade. I never minded the name. I only wanted to hold the line a little longer. They will call you by my name now. But not everyone who carries it holds the line. Nothing stands at the border anymore.
